composition_subtypes.role: Binary search to find longest feasible segment
Greedy take longest segment per day

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy selection of longest segment per day via binary search on length with RMQ from DP-built sparse table.
payload.rationale: Solution combines greedy segment selection, binary search for feasibility, and DP precomputation (sparse table) for range maximum queries, working in tandem.
